literature_claim: The PPI benchmark contains 24 tissue graphs; OhmNet contains tissue-specific PPI layers.
reconstruction_evidence: All 24 GraphSAGE graphs match specific supplied OhmNet tissue edgelists exactly after recovering row identities; all node and edge sets reconcile.
recommended_report_wording: The GraphSAGE PPI topology is a 24-graph subset of the supplied OhmNet tissue-network collection.

literature_claim: The global network combines experimentally supported physical interactions from Orchard/MIntAct, Rolland, BioGRID, HPRD, CORUM, Ruepp, and Menche; it contains 21,557 proteins and 342,353 interactions.
reconstruction_evidence: The union of all 144 supplied OhmNet tissue edgelists equals the BioSNAP combined OhmNet file (70,338 unique pairs) and every union edge is present in the BioSNAP 21,557-node/342,353-edge global interactome.
relationship: agrees on the enlarged global network; refines source chain
recommended_report_wording: The OhmNet tissue edges are exact subsets of the BioSNAP 342,353-edge global physical-interactome file; BioGRID is one contributor, not the sole source.
notes: Per-edge attribution to individual databases is absent from the flattened files.

literature_claim: Menche compiled 141,296 interactions among 13,460 proteins from seven interaction classes.
reconstruction_evidence: OhmNet/BioSNAP reports and contains 342,353 edges among 21,557 nodes; therefore it is not byte-for-byte or numerically the Menche 2015 interactome.
recommended_report_wording: Menche 2015 describes an earlier 13,460-node/141,296-edge composite interactome. OhmNet uses a larger 21,557-node/342,353-edge resource, so its Menche citation should be read as methodological/source lineage rather than identity of the exact network.

literature_claim: Each tissue network is induced from the global network by interactions specifically co-expressed in that tissue under the Greene criterion.
reconstruction_evidence: The supplied 144 tissue networks collapse exactly to the BioSNAP combined file and are subsets of the global file. The intermediate gene-to-tissue calls were not independently reconstructed in this audit.
relationship: partially agrees; mechanism not fully independently verified
recommended_report_wording: The released edge sets are externally verified; the stated co-expression filtering rule is documented but its intermediate tissue-activity inputs remain to be reconstructed.

literature_claim: Features are positional gene sets, motif gene sets, and immunological signatures from MSigDB.
reconstruction_evidence: All 50 deposited columns are exactly 30 C1 positional sets followed by 20 C3 motif sets; no C7 column is present.
recommended_report_wording: The observed features contain C1 and C3 memberships only. A global 50-column cap could explain why a stated C7 stage contributed no columns, but the original implementation is not documented.

literature_claim: The literature does not specify how large MSigDB collections became 50 dimensions.
reconstruction_evidence: A source-order, source-size threshold near 200 genes, and global cap of 50 reconstruct every feature cell; the empty chryq11 column supports filtering before graph-universe intersection.
recommended_report_wording: State the exact reconstruction and its controls, while labeling >=200 versus >200, the literal C7 loop, and the MSigDB release as unresolved.

literature_claim: The 121 GO label sets were collected from MSigDB.
reconstruction_evidence: Direct memberships from supplied MSigDB 5.0, 5.1, 5.2, and 6.0 produce no exact label column. GOA human release 159 with one fixed evidence/relation/mapping/propagation policy reproduces all deposited cells under the recovered row map.
relationship: conflicts with a literal direct-membership reading
evidence_category: byte-level exact; literal upstream file still open
recommended_report_wording: The deposited label memberships are not direct memberships from the tested MSigDB releases. GOA v159 exactly reproduces them; MSigDB may have supplied term identities or an upstream candidate list.

literature_claim: Training uses 20 graphs and testing uses two entirely unseen graphs.
reconstruction_evidence: Each row has exactly one graph-level split, but 3,599 of 4,301 Entrez genes occur in more than one split and 3,067 occur in train, validation, and test.
relationship: statement is graph-wise true but biologically incomplete
recommended_report_wording: The held-out tissues are unseen graphs, but most biological gene identities are not unseen. Distinguish graph-level induction from entity-level novelty.

literature_claim: The released PPI files anonymize biological node identities; no mapping is distributed.
reconstruction_evidence: A legacy Python-2/NetworkX string-key order exactly reconstructs all rows and is cross-validated by topology, features, and labels.
evidence_category: strongly inferred with byte-level downstream confirmation
recommended_report_wording: Publish the recovered mapping, but call the historical ordering mechanism a forensic reconstruction rather than direct source-code proof.

literature_source: OhmNet paper; released archive; GraphSAGE paper
literature_claim: OhmNet experiments discuss 107 tissue layers; the public source package has 144 tissue edgelists; GraphSAGE uses 24.
reconstruction_evidence: The 24 GraphSAGE tissue identities are exact, but the rule selecting 24 from 144 and assigning 20/2/2 remains unresolved.
relationship: documented counts with open selection mechanism
recommended_report_wording: Report all three counts and do not imply that the 24 were the only OhmNet networks or a simple size-threshold sample.
